questionText: As an Advanced Accounting Analytics intern at Gringotts Bank, you are tasked with investigating factors that explain variation in account balances accrued by credit card holders. The credit.csv file contains a data set with information on 400 credit card account holders, including the following variables: Balance: credit card balance, i.e. debt owed to bank ($ dollars) Income: cardholder annual income ($ thousands of dollars) Limit: credit spending limit ($ dollars) Student: Yes/No indicator for whether or not the cardholder is a part-time or full-time student Fit a linear regression model for Balance in terms of the following predictors: Income Student Limit the interaction between Student and Limit Which of the following is an accurate interpretation of the results of this model? Select TRUE below for accurate interpretations or FALSE for inaccurate interpretations.

questionHtml:
As an Advanced Accounting Analytics intern at Gringotts Bank, you are tasked with investigating factors that explain variation in account balances accrued by credit card holders. The credit.csv file contains a data set with information on 400 credit card account holders, including the following variables:

    • Balance: credit card balance, i.e. debt owed to bank ($ dollars)
    • Income: cardholder annual income ($ thousands of dollars)
    • Limit: credit spending limit ($ dollars)
    • Student: Yes/No indicator for whether or not the cardholder is a part-time or full-time student

Fit a linear regression model for Balance in terms of the following predictors:

      1. Income
      2. Student
      3. Limit
      4. the interaction between Student and Limit

Which of the following is an accurate interpretation of the results of this model? Select TRUE below for accurate interpretations or FALSE for inaccurate interpretations.
